doc.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001

title: Which era she would live in
summary: She would not trade the present for another time, though Michelangelo's era appeals.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Is there a time in history, going back as far as you’d like, that you would have liked to participate in? © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-

I don’t know, maybe the time Michelangelo and the time these people that did many, many things at one time, and they also lived long, some of them lived long lives and they had a chance to really get into a lot of different fields and things. Maybe. I don’t know. I like it now.
So I don’t want to go back in history. But it’s exciting.
